verdict.rationale: Granola has a dedicated model-training doc page saying users can opt out of model training in Settings at any time, and it documents HIPAA compliance for Enterprise customers. The evidence only shows a per-user setting, not an admin-enforced org-wide opt-out, and SOC 2 is never mentioned. missing for 10: org-level enforceable training opt-out controlled by admins, SOC 2 attestation documentation, explicit statement of default training behavior, independent corroboration.
